interpretation: One sample per browser on the same fixed Linux CI runner class and saved input; these are observations, not production latency guarantees.
Initial time ends after step 0 and the first rendered 3D frame. Seek time includes Playwright input and assertion polling.
RSS sums browser-process descendants at milestones; it is not peak memory, JavaScript heap or incremental replay allocation. Shared pages may be counted repeatedly.
Payload bytes include repeated fixture responses, exclude HTTP headers and application bundles. Both browsers initially fetch 1 of 53 chunks (39700 payload bytes).
The unchanged 6000-step writer recording and receipt/checksums are in apps/web/test-fixtures/publication-long/provenance.json; regeneration requires review.

bundle.loading: Scene is dynamically imported by ReplayPanel; the Three/Fiber/Drei chunk loads on replay entry. Worker is a separate module. The 500 kB build warning remains visible; no size limit was raised.

dependencies.compatibility: React/DOM 19.3.0 satisfies Fiber >=19 <19.4 and Drei ^19; Three 0.186.0 satisfies Fiber >=0.156 and Drei >=0.159. Optional native/Expo peers are not browser requirements.
dependencies.assets: Production adds no external model, texture, asset CDN or physics engine. E2E font injection is a local test fixture.

observedCoverage.scope: Saved terrain occlusion (wall hits at steps 107/187/231), flight and fast projectiles; interval hit at step 139 tests timestamp and contact/path pairing. This recording ends before flight expiry.
New engine-generated input with flight/takeoff/sky-mage revision 2; duration 5, actual status-remove flight:expired at step 5. static-status-expiry compares the state at 4, 5 and reverse seek to 4.
Domain mutual-hit display fixture: both HP meters reach zero at the same step. It is display restoration evidence, not a new combat oracle.
Initial bounded loading, distant/backward/cached/overlapping seeks, camera interaction, speed and simulated visibility pause/resume preserve recorded state and result hash.

New #82 engine-generated recording (e2e/generate-stage-fixture.ts) loaded as local files: #61 stamina, walk/run, two-stage return cut, dash stage motion, radial blade and active forced motion. stage-display.test.ts and static-local-file check the labels and recorded-velocity arrows; placed areas and beams are not engine features and are not claimed.

limitations: Phone width and touch controls are checked only by Playwright mobile emulation (390x844, hasTouch, isMobile) on Linux Chromium/WebKit, using taps and on-screen camera buttons. Physical iPhone, iPad and Android devices, real drag/pinch gestures and actual operating-system suspension remain unverified.
Visibility testing overrides document.hidden and dispatches visibilitychange; it does not emulate OS process eviction.
Teleport and other unimplemented discontinuous abilities have no claimed fixture coverage. Add their saved display fixtures when those abilities are implemented.
Launch events without coordinates and effective vision altered by status without a recorded value are omitted and explained; coordinates/ranges are not invented.
Checksums demonstrate file integrity, not authenticity of an official result.
